subject: Film & Cinema
title: Ridley Scott: The Visual Architect
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ridley Scott: The Visual Architect.

hook.text: Scott built the worlds of Blade Runner and Alien — two of the most influential sci-fi films ever.

buildup.text: Trained as a painter, he approaches every frame as a visual composition first.

discovery.text: His production design creates immersive worlds that feel lived-in and textured.

twist.text: His filmography is wildly inconsistent — masterpieces sit next to forgettable blockbusters.

climax.text: At his best, Scott creates visual worlds no other director can match.

punchline.text: He doesn't direct films. He builds worlds.

quiz.question: What was Ridley Scott's background before filmmaking?
